name: C'lantaa
desc:
C'lantaa was a Tiran NPC.

He was found in [New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City](location:new_kyrsa) in a building with the teleporter to the tunnel near the vent into [The Sunken Railways](location:the_sunken_railways). Similar with other residents of the city, he is unable to recall his past aside from not having a well-off one.

He attempted to communicate with the local Kyrsgarde, but was wounded in the process. He suspects the mist is the vector by which [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye) is enslaving the Kyrsgarde.

He wore the Cala-Mariner outfit.
additional_info: -   C'lantaa's racial variant is a Jay.
